scope: Invented paired observations only; fixed supplied kinetics; no human inference or coverage claim

source.reference: Polonsky et al. 1986, DOI 10.1172/JCI112308, p99 process scheme; existing BC-003/1 ancestry

input_conversion: opent1d.observations/1 nmol/L C-peptide multiplied by exactly 1000; original bytes retained

method_rules.interpolation: piecewise linear central concentration on actual observed times; no extrapolation
method_rules.initial_central: V times observed C at 0; recomputed for every draw and subset
method_rules.initial_peripheral: fixed initial_peripheral_factor times k1/k2 times initial central; factor 1 is equilibrium
method_rules.integration: exact peripheral linear-forcing update and compartment mass balance per interval
method_rules.negative_rate_policy: retain calculated rates/totals and mark boundary failure; never clip
method_rules.missing_censored_policy: retain observation and fail affected visit; no imputation or LOQ substitution
method_rules.glucose_policy: retain measured traces, fasting glucose, AUC and meal/medication context; missing context prevents resolved classification
method_rules.cohort_inference: none; individual paired results and full coverage only

uncertainty_rules.kind: declared synthetic additive Gaussian perturbations, not an empirical assay model
uncertainty_rules.independent_component: one independent draw per retained C-peptide observation
uncertainty_rules.paired_component: one shared offset per participant and draw across both visits and all retained times
uncertainty_rules.variant_pairing: the same perturbed observations used across required variants
uncertainty_rules.refit: repeat baseline, initialization, interpolation and integration using only each draw's observations
uncertainty_rules.failure_policy: retain every draw and both visits; any failed required draw makes that variant interval unavailable
uncertainty_rules.interval: central nominal 95 percent perturbation interval; linear order-statistic interpolation; no human coverage claim
uncertainty_rules.interpretation: strictly above zero increase; strictly below zero decrease; otherwise unresolved, never evidence of no change

classification_rules.consistent within investigated assumptio: all required variants succeed with the same resolved direction
classification_rules.assumption-dependent: different direction labels with at least one resolved direction, all required variants otherwise complete
classification_rules.insufficiently determined: any required failed/missing variant or uncertainty draw, invalid import/context, or all labels unresolved

verification_tolerances_prespecified.source_forward_refinement: absolute endpoint error decreases over 15, 5, 1 and 0.25 minute grids with forcing changes retained
verification_tolerances_prespecified.fresh_process_repeat: exact JSON/Markdown bytes under the recorded runtime
verification_tolerances_prespecified.relocation_reconstruction: exact report bytes; original archive unchanged
